versions.name: S-F Scout Ranch
versions.summary: Sprawling 5,200-acre Greater St. Louis Area Council reservation on 270-acre Nims Lake near Farmington, Missouri. The ranch hosts the council's Scouts BSA resident camps—Camp Gamble (patrol-method campsite cooking) and Camp Famous Eagle (air-conditioned dining)—the Swift High Adventure Base, and the S-F Ranger program, plus Huck's Cove water park, the Eagle Range shooting complex, rock-climbing cliffs, and STEM programming.

Prompted by a community correction (Reddit, u/BTKSTLPKR).

provenance.notes: Re-scoped 2026-08-22 from resident_camp to reservation: the property is a grouping anchor for its sub-camps (Camp Gamble, Camp Famous Eagle, Swift High Adventure Base, S-F Ranger Program), which carry the per-camp features. Imported from camp-finder; raw description and sessions dropped (operational data stays at the council site). verified_at is camp-finder's own source-confirmation date; imported_at is when open-scout-api ingested it. The evergreen summary is original prose regenerated from that description, excluding dates/fees/schedules. camp_type classified from program_types. Features surveyed 2026-07-25 against the council's own camp page (that page is explicitly not an exhaustive activity list, so absence of a code is not evidence of absence).
